question.text: The Sponsor/Manager continuing interest in a Category III AIF must be:

answer.text: 2.5% of corpus or Rs. 5 crore, whichever is lower
5% of corpus or Rs. 10 crore, whichever is lower

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the Sponsor or Manager of a Category III AIF must have a continuing interest of at least 5% of the corpus or Rs. 10 crore, whichever is lower. The same threshold is confirmed in multiple places in the workbook. The Trap: 2.5% / Rs. 5 crore, 10% of corpus, and Rs. 25 crore absolute do not match the prescribed Category III continuing-interest requirement. Note: The 5% / Rs. 10 crore "whichever is lower" continuing-interest rule for Category III is set out in the AIF (Category III) Distributors workbook (Series XIX-B).
